stage0043_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Apparently there was a room like this
　at A Baoa Qu, the old Principality's
　last stronghold...」

stage0043_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Palau's governor is an ardent sympathizer
　of the old Principality of Zeon.
　One should accept kindness graciously, taste aside」

stage0043_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I consider that one mark of a leader too」

stage0043_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I suppose the Supreme Commander's much the same...」

stage0043_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「He's the same. He recognizes
　his own position, and strives
　to fulfill that role.」

stage0043_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well done.
　Captain, Lt. $$マリーダ$$, you may withdraw」

stage0043_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What's wrong?
　Have a seat」

stage0043_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「How are you feeling?
　I hear you've barely said a word
　since the transfer from Earth to Palau」

stage0043_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Can't share tea with someone you tried
　to kill, $$バナージ・リンクス$$?」

stage0043_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Good reaction.
　But reckless too.
　A pilot's temperament」

stage0043_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Forgive me, but is that mask
　hiding some kind of scar?」

stage0043_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If not, then I'd like you
　to show me your face」

stage0043_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's fine, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.
　$$バナージ$$ is only discussing manners」

stage0043_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is this to your satisfaction?」

stage0043_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0043_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm told I look just like him.
　I wasn't picked as a body double for nothing」

stage0043_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even so, there are subtle differences.
　This mask is meant to hide them,
　and it's something of a fashion too」

stage0043_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A reminder of $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s existence...
　You could call it propaganda」

stage0043_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No one speaks as frankly as you,
　so I tend to forget.
　Forgive the discourtesy」

stage0043_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That's what $$オードリー$$ said too...）

stage0043_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Much is still unclear about how you came
　to be entrusted with that mobile suit,
　the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, by the Vist Foundation」

stage0043_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That machine was originally
　meant to come to us,
　as you well know」

stage0043_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Why did $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ choose you
　to bear Laplace's Box...?」

stage0043_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...A slip of the tongue.
　Forget I said that」

stage0043_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...How I got that mobile suit is
　just as I told you before
　I was brought here. Nothing more」

stage0043_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「For us, it's hard to believe
　$$カーディアス・ビスト$$ entrusted it to a stranger」

stage0043_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If so, there must be some reason.
　...Perhaps you're tied to the Vist family too」

stage0043_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Am I obligated to answer...?」

stage0043_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I said stop, $$アンジェロ$$」

stage0043_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Don't push your luck, brat」

stage0043_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're not obligated.
　But since we want information too,
　we'll consider other means if we must」

stage0043_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What's so significant about Unicorn?
　Does it have something to do with
　this Laplace's Box thing?」

stage0043_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I told you to forget it, $$バナージ$$」

stage0043_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Let me ask you one thing.
　Is Unicorn significant enough
　for Neo Zeon to act over?」

stage0043_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Was that worth committing terrorism,
　worth taking people's lives one-sidedly!?
　No one has the right to that!」

stage0043_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The answer is yes.
　To change the Earth Federation's
　twisted system, and free the Spacenoids」

stage0043_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's precisely why
　Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$ rose up」

stage0043_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You're $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s body double,
　but you're not $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0043_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even through the footage, that person
　had warmth... the shape of a living person...
　But you...」

stage0043_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You!
　Trying to insult the Colonel!?」

stage0043_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's fine, $$アンジェロ$$.
　$$バナージ$$ seems to see through to the truth」

stage0043_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But you're still young.
　The world's still full of things you don't know」

stage0043_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「For instance, someone close to you...」

stage0043_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's still much for you to learn.
　I want you to understand us...
　I'd welcome you as an ally afterward」

stage0043_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You said I'm not the Supreme Commander」

stage0043_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I define myself as a vessel.
　One to hold the feelings of Spacenoids
　abandoned in space, heirs to Zeon's ideal」

stage0043_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If that's what they want,
　then I'll become $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　This mask exists for that」

stage0043_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll leave $$バナージ$$ to the Captain.
　Let him get to know Palau」

stage0043_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（The shape of a living person, hm...
　Well put, perhaps...）

stage0043_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（But someday, people will come to know...
　the truth behind $$シャア・アズナブル$$...）

stage0043_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0043_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0043_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0043_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0043_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$メラン$$
「...That's the briefing for the Palau raid operation」

stage0043_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Investigation suggests the core's already
　been moved to $$アクシズ$$, but Unicorn and $$バナージ$$
　are still most likely somewhere on Palau」

stage0043_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Retaking Unicorn matters too, since it'll help
　us glimpse part of Neo Zeon's strategy」

stage0043_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The operation's success rests on
　the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Count on you, Captain $$オットー$$」

stage0043_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Operation starts in four hours.
　Everyone, get ready」

stage0043_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Are you all right, Captain?」

stage0043_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$オットー$$
「There's nothing for it but to do it.
　Anaheim's pushing us too, through
　Mr. $$アルベルト$$, to reclaim their prized new unit」

stage0043_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Recovering Unicorn...
　I have no objection to that」

stage0043_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But we see this as
　a hostage rescue operation」

stage0043_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Because we owe him a debt
　from the fighting after Industrial 7」

stage0043_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$オットー$$
「...True enough.
　Time to repay that kid, it seems」

stage0043_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Are you all right, Captain?」

stage0043_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$オットー$$
「There's nothing for it but to do it.
　Anaheim's pushing us too, through
　Mr. $$アルベルト$$, to reclaim their prized new unit」

stage0043_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Recovering Unicorn...
　I have no objection to that」

stage0043_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But we see this as
　a hostage rescue operation」

stage0043_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Because, knowing you, Mr. $$ダグザ$$,
　I figured you'd say getting the Gundam
　back comes first, and $$バナージ$$ second」

stage0043_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「It's fine, $$正太郎$$.
　Prioritizing the mission is only natural」

stage0043_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But what outsiders say doesn't matter.
　We'll rescue $$バナージ・リンクス$$ on our own will」

stage0043_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「You probably don't know this,
　but this ship's crew owes him a debt」

stage0043_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You mean the battle after
　escaping Industrial 7?」

stage0043_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That's right.
　It was his do-or-die resolve
　that let us survive」

stage0043_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This operation is
　a good chance to repay that」

stage0043_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$オットー$$
「I know.
　My feelings are no different from the Lt. Colonel's」

stage0043_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's all right, $$オードリー$$.
　We'll save $$バナージ$$ ourselves, no matter what」

stage0043_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is it possible... something else is worrying you?」

stage0043_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's just that you've seemed down,
　$$オードリー$$... for a while now」

stage0043_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$n
「If it's hard to tell us,
　you could talk to Miss $$スズネ$$ instead」

stage0043_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If you don't mind, would you tell me?
　I'd like you free of regrets before we launch」

stage0043_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...We're going to attack Palau, aren't we...」

stage0043_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That place is a Neo Zeon base now.」

stage0043_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But it's originally a resource satellite.
　Many people unrelated to the military live there」

stage0043_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No need to worry, $$オードリー$$.
　Our goal is simply to rescue $$バナージ$$.」

stage0043_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't attack the residential district,
　nor do more damage to the facility than necessary」

stage0043_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I understand that as an ideal,
　but isn't it difficult in reality?」

stage0043_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll still do it.
　I won't accept war as a means to anything.」

stage0043_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll show $$シャア$$ that too.」

stage0043_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$赤木$$
「I agree with Captain $$アムロ$$ too.
　That Palau is an important home
　to the people who live there.」

stage0043_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カレン$$
「We're only striking Neo Zeon, nothing else.
　I promise you that, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0043_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$リディ$$
「So just sit tight and wait for us.」

stage0043_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's the idea.
　Will you trust us?」

stage0043_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ジン$$
「I mean it's inefficient.
　If we attack the residential district, the enemy's
　forces would scatter to defend it...」

stage0043_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジン$$
「If the residents panic,
　our op's success rate would go up too.」

stage0043_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I agree with $$ジン$$ this time.
　Even just a warning shot would make
　the operation easier to pull off.」

stage0043_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then just watch $c fight.
　We'll rescue $$バナージ$$ without
　resorting to that, I'll show you.」

stage0043_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Look who's talking, Daddy's Boy.
　So you're saying you're confident
　you can pull it off no matter how tough?」

stage0043_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Take it that way if you want.」

stage0043_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine.
　I'll take you up on that.」

stage0043_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea.
　I'm not okay with an inefficient plan.」

stage0043_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But someone at my level needs a handicap
　like that just to feel motivated.」

stage0043_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$...
　So you're against me too.」

stage0043_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's not it, $$ジン$$.
　I want you to understand too... our fight.」

stage0043_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Because you're one of us too, $$ジン$$...
　You're a member of $c.」

stage0043_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is too...
　That's why everyone's... trying so hard.」

stage0043_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Please pray the operation succeeds too, $$ジン$$.」

stage0043_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Zeta... made it in time?」

stage0043_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Maintenance is done, the $$ロト$$ for $$エコーズ$$
　included. Use it in the next operation.」

stage0043_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Count on you, $$カミーユ$$.
　Our job is to go meet him,
　then escort him straight to $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

stage0043_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I intend to do my best.」

stage0043_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シン$$
「You and Zeta together can definitely pull it off.」

stage0043_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シン$$
「We look out for each other, don't we?」

stage0043_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（What is this, what's going on...!?
　That Gundam was supposed to have been sealed
　by Anaheim for the sake of the UC Plan!）

stage0043_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What's wrong, $$アルベルト$$?
　You look surprised seeing Zeta.」

stage0043_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「N-nothing...!
　More importantly, get the Unicorn back!」

stage0043_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...An honest man.
　He's probably not bad at heart.」

stage0043_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Zeta and $$νガンダム$$...
　So it seems Anaheim had a hand in why
　these two Gundams never went to Londo Bell.」

stage0043_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is it because they're fitted for Newtypes?」

stage0043_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's probably the reason.
　The Earth supremacists running HQ
　despise the very idea of Newtypes.」

stage0043_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カツ$$
「So pressure from them
　is what moved Anaheim.」

stage0043_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So to them, Newtypes are still monsters...」

stage0043_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$チェーン$$
（I've heard this... that Captain $$アムロ$$, too,
　was kept under near house arrest for years
　after the $$一年戦争$$, by those fearing Newtypes.）

stage0043_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Still, I don't buy it.
　If those people and Anaheim are in league,
　how do you explain the Unicorn's existence?」

stage0043_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$チェーン$$
「That's true.
　The Unicorn is practically made of
　nothing but Psycoframe, after all.」

stage0043_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Since they developed a new Newtype Gundam,
　maybe they sealed away similar units
　to help promote it...?」

stage0043_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That would contradict the earlier point
　about ties to the Earth supremacists.」

stage0043_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Anaheim isn't a monolith either, after all.
　Especially lately, the $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$
　faction seems to be making its own moves.」

stage0043_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルベルト$$'s aunt, is it...
　So the Unicorn was born out of that current.」

stage0043_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$シン$$
「That's fine, isn't it.
　At least Zeta's back for now.」

stage0043_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カツ$$
「From what Captain $$ブライト$$ said,
　it sounds like $$ベルトーチカ$$ pulled through too.」

stage0043_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カツ$$
「A former 《$$カラバ$$》 member.
　A woman who still stays on Earth,
　helping support Londo Bell.」

stage0043_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カツ$$
（Don't say anything stupid.
　You want to put $$アムロ$$ on the spot?）

stage0043_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$シン$$
（Put him on the spot how?）

stage0043_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$カツ$$
（You're slow, $$シン$$...
　Haven't you noticed $$チェーン$$'s been
　making a move on $$アムロ$$?）

stage0043_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$チェーン$$
「What's wrong, $$シン$$?
　And you looked like you had something to say...」

stage0043_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Well, never mind.
　...It's about time to take combat stations.」

stage0043_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I have operation instructions for $$カミーユ$$.
　$$シン$$, $$カツ$$, go on ahead.」

stage0043_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$シン$$
「Let's do our best, $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0043_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...About how Zeta was obtained?」

stage0043_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If Anaheim had Zeta sealed away,
　even with $$カラバ$$ or Luio & Co. pushing back,
　it shouldn't have gone this smoothly.」

stage0043_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Something with enough power to override
　Supreme Command's wishes must be behind it.」

stage0043_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Just as you guessed.
　Zeta was delivered to Londo Bell by the hand
　of the missing Lt. $$アポリー$$, apparently.」

stage0043_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's Neo Zeon's... $$シャア$$'s doing, I'd bet.」

stage0043_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アムロ$$
「To Anaheim, Neo Zeon is a client too,
　and Lt. $$アポリー$$ is his personal subordinate.
　That's the only way I can figure it.」

stage0043_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't like being moved around
　on $$シャア$$'s palm?」

stage0043_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It doesn't matter.
　I'm not hesitating anymore.」

stage0043_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Right now I'll focus on rescuing $$バナージ$$ with Zeta.」

stage0043_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Count on it.
　If we get $$バナージ$$ back, we might learn
　why Neo Zeon wants the Unicorn so badly.」

stage0043_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Sorry about that, kid.
　You came all this way to eat dinner
　at my place, and my son had to start something.」

stage0043_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This is a Neo Zeon base,
　and I really am helping the Federation...」

stage0043_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Yeah, well.
　But it's the Federation and Zeon at war,
　not you and me.」

stage0043_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「So, well... don't worry about it too much.」

stage0043_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'll take it from here.
　$$ギルボア$$, go home.」

stage0043_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「I'll do that.
　It's been a while since I've been home,
　so the kids must be dying for attention.」

stage0043_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What you said at dinner,
　that there's no such thing as a just war...」

stage0043_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I've no intention of taking it back.
　No matter how much Zeon claims to be freeing
　the Spacenoids, war still kills countless people...」

stage0043_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Zeon says the Federation's to blame for the war,
　but that's wrong... it's not right!」

stage0043_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「There's no such thing as a just war...
　But being right doesn't always save people.」

stage0043_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Speaking of the early space settlers,
　they were people down on their luck on Earth,
　political criminals, with no other way to live.」

stage0043_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「When $$宇宙世紀$$ began under $$ＵＣＷ$$,
　the premier called it a split from the age of gods...」

stage0043_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「But those forced to live in the dark of space
　needed a light to cling to」

stage0043_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Without light, people can't go on living.
　But those abandoned in space
　eventually found a light to replace the gods」

stage0043_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「A new light, called Zeon...」

stage0043_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「They needed it.
　To resist despair and keep living
　in a cruel, unfree world...」

stage0043_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「People can live fine without such things,
　clinging to something with no substance is foolish...」

stage0043_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If anyone can say that for certain...
　they're either extremely fortunate,
　or disconnected from the world」

stage0043_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans possess gods...
　someone told me once, a power that
　transcends the now, an inner god named possibility...」

stage0043_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「A romantic, huh...
　Words like that don't come without believing
　in people and the world. Must've been a kind soul」

stage0043_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I've talked too much...
　must be because it's been a while off duty」

stage0043_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Um... could you tell me your name?」

stage0043_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you pilot mobile suits too,
　$$マリーダ$$?」

stage0043_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「N-no... that person seemed drunk...
　and just bumped into me out of nowhere...」

stage0043_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I was handed a note...?
　What... is this...）

stage0043_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Recovering me alone doesn't end the operation...
　We can't stay here, not me... not you either...」

stage0043_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!」

stage0043_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Is the $c attack outside
　to take back you and the Unicorn...!」

stage0043_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let me go, $$マリーダ$$!
　If I can just get this Unicorn back,
　$c will leave this place!」

stage0043_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's just an excuse!
　As if I'd leave Palau, a Neo Zeon
　stronghold, unguarded!」

stage0043_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Just focus on ending this fight now!
　At this rate, the people living in Palau,
　even $$ギルボア$$'s family, could get caught up in it!」

stage0043_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's your excuse!
　While keeping the Princess prisoner...」

stage0043_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!!」

stage0043_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Confirmed the Unicorn's NT-D activation.
　It appears to be engaging the $$クシャトリヤ$$」

stage0043_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Psycho-Monitor's sensitivity looks good too.
　No issues monitoring from here on」

stage0043_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Just as you intended, Colonel」

stage0043_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To activate the NT-D, there's no way
　but to pit it against a suspected Newtype」

stage0043_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Psycho-Monitor fitted to the Unicorn
　in Palau will intercept the NT-D's activation」

stage0043_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That should let us gather the Laplace
　Program data we couldn't
　analyze on our own」

stage0043_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Still, to think even an Enhanced Human
　could activate the NT-D...」

stage0043_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「An Enhanced Human can't be called a true Newtype.
　But with no one able to say what a true Newtype
　even is, what we need is the phenomenon itself」

stage0043_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That brat called $$バナージ$$...
　will he really be able to master the Unicorn?」

stage0043_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Once swallowed by the NT-D,
　one could say his own skill hardly matters」

stage0043_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Right now, the NT-D system is what moves
　that machine. The pilot's just a processor now,
　converting received brainwaves into hostility」

stage0043_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The NT-D... what a terrifying system」

stage0043_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Newtype Destroyer System...
　Once it identifies the enemy as a Newtype,
　the machine's limiters release」

stage0043_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A hunting machine with a paranormal
　interface born of the Psycoframe」

stage0043_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「As the system matures further,
　it may gain power to dominate enemy Psycommu weapons」

stage0043_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That machine... no ordinary person could handle it...!」

stage0043_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's right.
　Which is precisely why we need an Enhanced Human」

stage0043_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's the plan known as the UC Project.
　Once the Enhanced Human, tech's own product,
　drives it out, the Newtype is buried for good」

stage0043_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Then, Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$ is...」

stage0043_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Pitiable, but she'll have to be sacrificed.
　She's endured such a harsh fate,
　it's about time she was allowed to rest」

stage0043_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Proto Ple Twelve...
　The artificial Newtype project through cloning...」

stage0043_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To her, the twelfth prototype...
　let us pay our respects, Lieutenant $$マリーダ・クルス$$」

stage0043_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Confirmed the Unicorn's NT-D activation.

$$フロンタル$$
「It happened on the battlefield.
　The Supreme Commander will surely understand」

stage0043_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:

「Though for my part, I had
　Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$ deploy precisely so

stage0043_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$バナージ$$
（But, it's no use...
　My body... won't move...）

stage0043_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Reject the Unicorn, the NT-D!」

stage0043_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't lose to the machine!
　You're fighting on your own will, aren't you!」

stage0043_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't let the Unicorn become a devil's machine!
　At this rate, it'll become something that kills
　the Newtype's existence, humanity's potential!」

stage0043_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The future... hope...
　Ending the war... understanding someone...
　coming together... that is...）

stage0043_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Good work, $$ナナイ$$.
　I'll hear your report on $$クェス$$ at length later」

stage0043_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「That girl's talent is genuine.
　Emotionally she's a bit unstable,
　but she'll be an asset in battle」

stage0043_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Bothered by Newtypes being used as tools of war...?」

stage0043_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$シャア$$
「I suppose that makes me soft too」

stage0043_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「I've sent $$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$ this way.
　After some adjustments, I plan to send
　them both to Commander $$ハマーン$$」

stage0043_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ wants to make a name for himself.
　$$ハマーン$$ should know how to use him well」

stage0043_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「As for $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　what do you plan to do?」

stage0043_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I believe I understand what you mean, $$ナナイ$$.
　But for now, let him do as he likes」

stage0043_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「In the battle on Earth, he reportedly
　used members of the $$マーティアル$$ cult
　he hired on his own authority」

stage0043_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$シャア$$
「The god of war from $$アストラギウス$$, huh...
　I hear it teaches that people evolve
　through battle」

stage0043_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$シャア$$
「For those who use Newtypes as tools of war,
　it may well be a fitting god...」

stage0043_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$シャア$$
「But we are Spacenoids.
　By believing in the infinite future we carve
　for ourselves, we broke from the idea of gods」

stage0043_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$シャア$$
「One could say the inner god named possibility
　has slain the old gods」

stage0043_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「And now, Colonel, you seek to overthrow
　the Earth Federation and bury the old order」

stage0043_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$シャア$$
「...As for $$フロンタル$$, let him do as he likes.
　Plenty of people believe in that man, after all」

stage0043_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$シャア$$
「Besides, trying to get Laplace's Box
　means dealing with $c in the end」

stage0043_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$シャア$$
「Though... I'd hate for $c
　to go down too easily, either...」

stage0043_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Do you know what's inside the box, Colonel?」

stage0043_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know the details.
　The only one in the world who knew, most likely,
　was the late $$カーディアス・ビスト$$」

stage0043_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Laplace's Box, a thing that could upend the world...
　$$フロンタル$$ is obsessed with that legend」

stage0043_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$シャア$$
「And hidden within it lies another truth...」

stage0043_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$シャア$$
「While investigating the truth behind my father
　Zeon Zum Deikun's death, I stumbled onto the Earth
　Federation's first prime minister's assassination」

stage0043_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Besides both being an unexplained death
　of a leader, is there a link between them...?」

stage0043_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$シャア$$
「To solve that, we'd need Laplace's Box.
　Trace either assassination's background,
　and you run into those very words.」

stage0043_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「The Federation and Zeon leaders' murders...
　Laplace's Box...」

stage0043_03:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$シャア$$
「But I don't need to rely on such
　conspiracies to change the world.
　For now, I'll leave the front to $$フロンタル$$」

stage0043_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$シャア$$
「A private friend of mine will arrive soon.
　Sorry, but $$ナナイ$$, please leave us.」

stage0043_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$シャア$$
（Laplace's Box...
　I doubt that information capable of shifting
　the world's balance in an instant truly exists）

stage0043_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$シャア$$
（No... that's not something I should say
　right now...）

stage0043_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$シャア$$
（At the very least, its existence surely
　held some meaning in humanity's history...）

stage0043_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Should I say it's been a while, Captain $$クワトロ$$?」

stage0043_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$シャア$$
「Right now, I go by $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　That's what you should call me.」

stage0043_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then answer this, $$シャア$$.
　Can you change this twisted world?」

stage0043_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$シャア$$
「At the very least, I bear this name
　with that resolve.」

stage0043_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$五飛$$
「...Very well.
　I'll trust that look in your eyes.」

stage0043_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$シャア$$
「There's a reason I called you here.
　I have a favor to ask, will you hear me out?」

stage0043_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$スザク$$
「If you're asking us to join Neo Zeon,
　we refuse.」

stage0043_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it.
　There's something I want you to look into.」

stage0043_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$シャア$$
「You've heard from $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$, it seems...」

stage0043_03:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$シャア$$
「As you guessed, $$ゼロ$$.
　I want you to pursue UG, and beyond it,
　whoever stands behind it.」

stage0043_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　Though even I have only a vague idea of it.」

stage0043_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I made it back, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0043_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I owe you and everyone at $c
　my gratitude.」

stage0043_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you for not letting Palau
　burn in the flames of war...」

stage0043_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Could the Princess Ms. $$マリーダ$$ mentioned...
　really be $$オードリー$$ after all...）

stage0043_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$バナージ$$
（And that Laplace's Box $$フル・フロンタル$$
　mentioned... what could it possibly be...）

stage0043_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$シン$$
「You...!
　Making us worry like that!」

stage0043_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$カミーユ$$, Mr. $$シン$$!
　And everyone else too...!」

stage0043_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$甲児$$
「If something happened to you, I couldn't face $$沙慈$$.」

stage0043_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$カトル$$
「But Ms. $$ミコット$$ was just as happy as
　Ms. $$オードリー$$ that $$バナージ$$ was safe.」

stage0043_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Come on, $$ミコット$$!
　Let's just enjoy this moment!」

stage0043_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm glad, $$バナージ$$.
　That we could meet again like this.」

stage0043_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$宗介$$
「A soldier's greatest duty is to return alive.
　You have fulfilled it.」

stage0043_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$n
「Sorry, $$バナージ$$.
　That's just $$宗介$$'s own way of welcoming you.」

stage0043_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ジン$$
（What is this feeling...
　Seeing everyone laugh and celebrate
　makes something stir in me too...）

stage0043_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's because, $$ジン$$...
　you're a part of $c too.」

stage0043_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You don't need to say it, $$ジン$$.
　I was the same way once.」

stage0043_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Now I can laugh together with everyone.
　Because I'm part of $c」

stage0043_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Well done yourself, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$.」

stage0043_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We did manage to recover the Unicorn,
　but we can't afford to be careless.」

stage0043_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Did Neo Zeon achieve its goal
　by capturing the Unicorn?」

stage0043_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$バナージ$$, the only one who can start
　the Unicorn, hasn't done anything. So I doubt it...」

stage0043_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll need to stay on guard, then.」

stage0043_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「True enough...
　Still, no harm in savoring joy a while.」

stage0043_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Great work too, $$カミーユ$$.
　I don't know what would've happened
　if you hadn't drawn out the Zeta's power」

stage0043_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That word, Laplace, that I heard
　when I touched $$バナージ$$'s mind bothers me」

stage0043_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't know what it means.
　But $$バナージ$$ seemed to feel
　torn about that word」

stage0043_03:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Why not just ask him yourself?」

stage0043_03:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No...
　Since $$バナージ$$'s hiding it himself,
　we should just watch and wait」

stage0043_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「My gut says it's connected to the Unicorn, but...」

stage0043_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Asking Mr. $$アルベルト$$ would be pointless.
　Same goes for the NT-D. That unit's secrets
　are sacred to him, no question.」

stage0043_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Unicorn's secret...
　Maybe that's what Neo Zeon, no,
　what $$フル・フロンタル$$ is after too」

stage0043_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not out of the question...
　But I'd rather not have any more preconceptions
　about a Unicorn that's already so unclear」

stage0043_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll report this to $$ブライト$$ myself,
　but keep it between us for now」

stage0043_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Neo Zeon's moves regarding the Unicorn
　seem separate from their overall strategy」

stage0043_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That $$フル・フロンタル$$ must be tasked
　with hunting down the Unicorn」

stage0043_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What will Neo Zeon do next, I wonder...」

stage0043_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The Supreme HQ, already packed with Earth
　supremacists, plan to muster a fleet against Neo Zeon」

stage0043_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So it'll be all-out war...」

stage0043_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Had confirming wartime law between us been delayed,
　those supremacists might have ordered
　indiscriminate attacks on the colonies...」

stage0043_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did he see this coming...」

stage0043_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That doesn't mean I'll accept his methods」

stage0043_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If possible, I'd like to end this war
　quickly by taking down $$シャア$$...」

stage0043_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　We'll walk our own path）

stage0043_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（If you're the one who gave me the Zeta,
　then I'll simply fight with its power.
　To stop you... to stop this war...）

stage0043_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, Master $$バナージ$$.
　Reliving your days on Palau, weren't you?」

stage0043_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'Spill the Unicorn's secrets,' they said,
　in brutal interrogations, day after day...」

stage0043_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But amid it all, a detective brings you
　a bowl of katsudon, and your heart softens...」

stage0043_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In short, the pilot of that four-winged one
　was that very detective, wasn't it!?」

stage0043_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Hearing that after so long feels nostalgic.
　Makes it feel real that I'm actually back.」

stage0043_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You were trying to ease my mind, weren't you.」

stage0043_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, well... that's... about the size of it, yes」

stage0043_03:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Oh my, this is a problem...
　If you answer like that, I won't be able
　to ask about the four-winged one's pilot...）

stage0043_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Between that pilot and Master $$バナージ$$, there
　was truly a bond of hearts. And when you shot
　her down, that intense emotion birthed 50Z of Z-Chips）

stage0043_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I'll add this to the squad's stock.
　For now, welcome back, Master $$バナージ$$...）

stage0043_03:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you intend to do from here on?」

stage0043_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Once things settle down, I'm supposed
　to talk with father, but...」

stage0043_03:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Setting your father aside for now,
　what is it that you want to do, Master $$ハサウェイ$$?」

stage0043_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...I want to bring $$クェス$$ back」

stage0043_03:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I intend to fight for that」

stage0043_03:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s resolve
　has reached even this $$ＡＧ$$」

stage0043_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please, do be careful...
　From here on, Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s actions
　may sway your family's fate as well」

stage0043_03:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If your son were to die in battle,
　your mother would blame your father, and sister grieve.」

stage0043_03:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I won't... I won't make my loved ones cry.
　And I will bring $$クェス$$ back, no matter what.」

stage0043_03:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the spirit.
　Now, praying light finds Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s future...」

stage0043_03:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today too, full steam ahead... business, business!」
